newsitem.title: UK: IPE oil futures holding lower levels after losses.
newsitem.headline: IPE oil futures holding lower levels after losses.

text.p: IPE Brent crude futures were holding at the lower levels with support intact after U.S. stock-related selling pressure inflicted early losses, traders said.
At 1304 GMT August Brent was off 30 cents to test support at $18.50 with gas oil down $1.50 at $166.25, with initial support at $166. Traders said they were now looking to NYMEX for fresh impetus.

Victor Yu, analyst at Refco, said he was surprised that the market had read so much downside into the APIs. "It's now a question of whether the (WTI) market can stay down below $20 but if it doesn't make it back today there are some good supports at previous resistance levels in the $19.65-70 region," Yu said.
However, despite the weaker start analysts remain bullish for Brent as long as initial supports are held.
"There may initially be some correction on crude if gas oil turns tail and heads lower, but good supports are now in place at the mid to lower $18 level," one analyst said.

Gas oil continued to strengthen on Tuesday after breaking down resistance at $167.25 the top of a gap-down earlier in the month to close at $167.75. The next target could be the $179.50 high from mid-May, but analysts said the narrow trading ranges over the last few days may mean the market is running out of steam to the upside.
